description: Freight Cars Moved in Carfloat Operations, Port Authority of NY NJ: Beginning 2009 is a dataset listed in State of New York open data portal (data.ny.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of New York. This dataset provides volume of loaded freight rail cars transported between NY and NJ by New York New Jersey Rail, a carfloat operation owned by the Port Authority of NY & NJ. Total volume, including empty cars, is estimated at twice the volume of loaded. 2013 entry is year-to-date volume at this time. Coverage: New York State. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are port authority, nynjr, rail, carfloat. The table has 4 columns. Attribution on the portal: Port Authority of New York and New Jersey. The portal shows 2016-03-15 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ny-gov-portal.
